is_anopheles.evidence: The paper explicitly states in the title and throughout the text that it studies Culex quinquefasciatus, not Anopheles.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports kdr and ace-1 mutations in Culex quinquefasciatus, which are not among the specified Anopheles-specific markers listed in the instructions.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for kdr and ace-1 mutations for four populations.

african_field_population.evidence: The study collected Culex quinquefasciatus from four localities in Benin.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four localities: Kandi, Houeyiho, Banikoara, and Natitingou.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from January to December 2013.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study appears to be a routine field collection.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study assesses insecticide resistance in Culex quinquefasciatus populations in Benin. It is ineligible because it does not study Anopheles mosquitoes.
